basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/TOPdesk/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. [TOPdesk ITSM](https://www.topdesk.com/en/itsm-software/) is the ultimate hub for IT teams, streamlining everything from urgent fixes to routine requests. Read this guide to explore its benefits, compare various solutions, and find the perfect fit to enhance your organization's IT management. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs a. options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for the TOPdesk ITSM Incidents API. You can get TOPdesk ITSM Incidents API custom log data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view. For more information about the TOPdesk ITSM Incidents API please check their [API documentation](https://developers.topdesk.com/tutorial.html).
